output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is multiplied by 10 ** uint256(decimals), which can overflow if initialSupply is large enough.
The transfer function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], which can be exploited to prevent transfers.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from], which can overflow if balanceOf[_from] is small and _value is large.
The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The mintedAmount is added to balanceOf[target], which can overflow if mintedAmount is large.
The mintedAmount is added to totalSupply, which can overflow if mintedAmount is large.
